work.description: The doctrinal note of the Dicastery for the Doctrine of the Faith on Marian titles regarding Mary's cooperation in the work of salvation, approved by Pope Leo XIV on 7 October 2025 and published 4 November 2025 over the signatures of Cardinal Victor Manuel Fernandez, Prefect, and Msgr. Armando Matteo, Secretary for the Doctrinal Section. Loci are the note's numbered paragraphs.
